events.title: Magna Carta is sealed
events.fact: King John seals the charter at Runnymede.
events.label: Magna Carta is sealed

events.title: The Statue of Liberty is dedicated
events.fact: The statue, a gift from France, is dedicated in New York Harbor.
events.label: Statue of Liberty is dedicated

events.title: Fleming discovers penicillin
events.fact: Alexander Fleming notices that mold inhibits bacterial growth.
events.label: Fleming discovers penicillin

events.title: Disneyland opens in California
events.fact: Walt Disney’s theme park opens in Anaheim, with a televised dedication on July 17.
events.label: Disneyland opens in California

events.title: The first iPhone is unveiled
events.fact: Steve Jobs introduces Apple’s first iPhone in January.
events.label: The first iPhone is unveiled

events.title: Zheng He begins his first treasure voyage
events.fact: The Ming fleet leaves China on the first of seven major expeditions across Asian waters.
events.label: Zheng He’s first treasure voyage

events.title: The Bastille is stormed
events.fact: The Paris uprising becomes a defining moment of the French Revolution.
events.label: The Bastille is stormed

events.title: Bell receives his telephone patent
events.fact: Alexander Graham Bell receives US patent 174,465.
events.label: Bell patents the telephone

events.title: Amelia Earhart flies solo across the Atlantic
events.fact: She becomes the first woman to make the solo crossing.
events.label: Earhart crosses the Atlantic solo

events.title: The Hubble Space Telescope launches
events.fact: Space Shuttle Discovery carries the telescope into orbit.
events.label: Hubble launches

events.title: Columbus reaches the Caribbean
events.fact: His first Atlantic voyage reaches the Caribbean in October.
events.label: Columbus reaches the Caribbean

events.title: Darwin sets sail on HMS Beagle
events.fact: The ship leaves Plymouth on a survey voyage that will help shape Darwin’s later ideas.
events.label: Darwin sets sail on the Beagle

events.title: The Eiffel Tower opens
events.fact: The tower is built for the Paris world’s fair.
events.label: The Eiffel Tower opens

events.title: Japan’s first Shinkansen line opens
events.fact: The Tōkaidō Shinkansen begins service between Tokyo and Shin-Osaka shortly before the Tokyo Olympics.
events.label: Japan’s first bullet train line

events.title: Dolly the sheep is born
events.fact: Dolly is the first mammal cloned from an adult somatic cell.
events.label: Dolly the sheep is born

events.title: The Battle of Hastings is fought
events.fact: William of Normandy defeats King Harold II, a turning point in the Norman conquest of England.
events.label: The Battle of Hastings

events.title: Pride and Prejudice is published
events.fact: Jane Austen’s novel introduces Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy.
events.label: Pride and Prejudice debuts

events.title: The Panama Canal opens
events.fact: The canal opens to traffic, connecting the Atlantic and Pacific oceans through Panama.
events.label: The Panama Canal opens

events.title: Sputnik 1 reaches orbit
events.fact: The Soviet satellite becomes the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.
events.label: Sputnik 1 reaches orbit

events.title: Wikipedia launches
events.fact: The free online encyclopedia opens on January 15.
events.label: Wikipedia launches

events.title: Martin Luther writes the Ninety-five Theses
events.fact: Luther challenges the sale of indulgences in a text that helps spark the Protestant Reformation.
events.label: Luther writes his 95 theses

events.title: The Suez Canal opens
events.fact: The canal creates a direct water route between the Mediterranean and Red seas.
events.label: The Suez Canal opens

events.title: Amundsen’s team reaches the South Pole
events.fact: Roald Amundsen and four companions become the first expedition to reach the geographic South Pole.
events.label: Amundsen reaches the South Pole

events.title: Pong is released
events.fact: Atari’s arcade table-tennis game becomes an early video-game hit.
events.label: Pong is released

events.title: The first image of a black hole is released
events.fact: The Event Horizon Telescope reveals the black hole in galaxy M87.
events.label: The first black hole image

events.title: Copernicus publishes his heliocentric model
events.fact: On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres places the Sun at the center of its model.
events.label: Copernicus publishes his model

events.title: The Stockton and Darlington Railway opens
events.fact: Its opening train is hauled by Locomotion No. 1, an early milestone for public steam railways.
events.label: Stockton–Darlington rail opens

events.title: The first modern Olympics take place
events.fact: Athens hosts the first Games of the modern Olympic era.
events.label: The first modern Olympics

events.title: India gains independence
events.fact: British rule ends and India becomes independent on August 15, amid the partition of British India.
events.label: India gains independence

events.title: The first Star Wars film opens
events.fact: The original film introduces Luke Skywalker, Leia, and Darth Vader.
events.label: Star Wars opens in cinemas

events.title: The first voyage around the world is completed
events.fact: Juan Sebastián Elcano brings Victoria back to Spain after Magellan’s death during the expedition.
events.label: First voyage around the world

events.title: On the Origin of Species is published
events.fact: Charles Darwin presents his theory of evolution by natural selection.
events.label: Darwin publishes Origin of Species

events.title: Tutankhamun’s tomb is discovered
events.fact: Howard Carter’s team finds the entrance in Egypt’s Valley of the Kings.
events.label: Tutankhamun’s tomb is found

events.title: Ernő Rubik invents his puzzle cube
events.fact: The Hungarian designer creates the twisting cube later known around the world as Rubik’s Cube.
events.label: Rubik invents his puzzle cube

events.title: The James Webb Space Telescope launches
events.fact: The telescope launches on December 25.
events.label: The Webb telescope launches

events.title: Shakespeare’s First Folio is published
events.fact: Fellow actors collect 36 of Shakespeare’s plays in a volume published after his death.
events.label: Shakespeare’s First Folio debuts

events.title: The US Declaration of Independence is adopted
events.fact: The Continental Congress adopts the Declaration on July 4.
events.label: US independence is declared

events.title: Röntgen discovers X-rays
events.fact: Wilhelm Röntgen identifies a form of radiation that can reveal structures inside the body.
events.label: Röntgen discovers X-rays

events.title: The United Nations is founded
events.fact: The UN Charter enters into force on October 24.
events.label: The United Nations is founded

events.title: New Horizons flies past Pluto
events.fact: The NASA spacecraft returns close-up views of the dwarf planet.
events.label: New Horizons flies past Pluto

events.title: The Taj Mahal’s main mausoleum is completed
events.fact: The central tomb is finished before the surrounding complex, which takes several more years.
events.label: Taj Mahal’s main tomb completed

events.title: Frankenstein is published
events.fact: Mary Shelley’s novel first appears anonymously.
events.label: Frankenstein is published

events.title: The first Nobel Prizes are awarded
events.fact: The first awards honor achievements in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace.
events.label: The first Nobel Prizes

events.title: Hillary and Norgay reach Everest’s summit
events.fact: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay make the first confirmed ascent.
events.label: Hillary and Norgay summit Everest

events.title: Pac-Man debuts in Japan
events.fact: Namco’s maze game introduces its dot-eating hero and four pursuing ghosts.
events.label: Pac-Man debuts in Japan

events.title: The Great Fire of London breaks out
events.fact: A fire starting in a bakery on Pudding Lane spreads through much of the old City of London.
events.label: The Great Fire of London

events.title: Mendeleev presents his periodic table
events.fact: His arrangement groups elements by their properties and leaves room for elements still to be discovered.
events.label: Mendeleev’s periodic table

events.title: The Wright brothers make their first powered flight
events.fact: Their aircraft takes off at Kill Devil Hills, near Kitty Hawk in North Carolina.
events.label: The Wrights’ first powered flight

events.title: Disney’s Snow White premieres
events.fact: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premieres in Los Angeles as Disney’s first animated feature.
events.label: Disney’s Snow White premieres

events.title: The first International Space Station module launches
events.fact: Zarya becomes the first piece of the orbiting station.
events.label: The first ISS module launches

events.title: Newton publishes Principia
events.fact: His landmark work describes the laws of motion and universal gravitation.
events.label: Newton publishes Principia

events.title: Yellowstone becomes a national park
events.fact: A US law establishes Yellowstone National Park, protecting its geysers and landscapes.
events.label: Yellowstone becomes a park

events.title: The first FIFA World Cup takes place
events.fact: Host nation Uruguay wins the inaugural tournament.
events.label: The first FIFA World Cup

events.title: The Sydney Opera House opens
events.fact: Queen Elizabeth II formally opens the harbor-side performing arts center.
events.label: The Sydney Opera House opens

events.title: Toy Story opens in cinemas
events.fact: Pixar releases the first fully computer-animated feature film.
events.label: Toy Story opens in cinemas

events.title: The Rosetta Stone is found
events.fact: French soldiers find the inscribed stone in Egypt; its parallel texts later help unlock hieroglyphs.
events.label: The Rosetta Stone is found

events.title: London’s Great Exhibition opens
events.fact: The Crystal Palace in Hyde Park houses displays of industry and design from around the world.
events.label: The Great Exhibition opens

events.title: Insulin is first used to treat a person with diabetes
events.fact: Leonard Thompson receives insulin in Toronto; a purified preparation makes the treatment successful.
events.label: Insulin first treats diabetes

events.title: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space
events.fact: Vostok 1 carries him on a single orbit of Earth.
events.label: Gagarin becomes first in space

events.title: The Berlin Wall opens
events.fact: East Germany opens border crossings on November 9.
events.label: The Berlin Wall opens

events.title: The Treaty of Waitangi is first signed
events.fact: Representatives of the British Crown and Māori chiefs sign the treaty at Waitangi in New Zealand.
events.label: Treaty of Waitangi first signed

events.title: New Zealand grants women the parliamentary vote
events.fact: A new electoral law gives women the right to vote in parliamentary elections.
events.label: New Zealand women win the vote

events.title: The Hobbit is published
events.fact: J. R. R. Tolkien introduces readers to Bilbo Baggins.
events.label: The Hobbit is published

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.fact: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the lunar surface.
events.label: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon

events.title: Discovery of a Higgs-like boson is announced
events.fact: CERN announces a new particle consistent with the Higgs boson.
events.label: A Higgs-like boson is discovered

events.title: Neptune is identified as a planet
events.fact: Johann Galle observes the planet near the position predicted by Urbain Le Verrier.
events.label: Neptune is discovered

events.title: The Titanic sinks
events.fact: The ocean liner strikes an iceberg during its maiden voyage.
events.label: The Titanic sinks

events.title: The People’s Republic of China is proclaimed
events.fact: Mao Zedong announces the founding of the new state in Beijing on October 1.
events.label: People’s Republic of China begins

events.title: The Space Shuttle makes its first orbital flight
events.fact: Columbia launches on mission STS-1.
events.label: First Space Shuttle orbital flight

events.title: Nelson Mandela becomes South Africa’s president
events.fact: He is inaugurated after South Africa’s first national election with universal adult suffrage.
events.label: Mandela becomes president

events.title: The Red Cross committee is founded
events.fact: A committee forms in Geneva to improve care for wounded soldiers; it becomes the ICRC.
events.label: The Red Cross committee forms

events.title: Voyager 1 launches
events.fact: NASA launches the spacecraft toward Jupiter and Saturn; it later travels into interstellar space.
events.label: Voyager 1 launches

events.title: The first website becomes publicly available
events.fact: Tim Berners-Lee shares the World Wide Web project with the public.
events.label: The first website goes public

events.title: The first Pokémon games launch in Japan
events.fact: Pocket Monsters Red and Green arrive on the Game Boy, beginning the Pokémon game series.
events.label: The first Pokémon games launch

events.title: Philae lands on a comet
events.fact: Rosetta’s lander touches down on comet 67P, the first landing on a comet’s nucleus.
events.label: Philae lands on a comet
